name: Eric Gitangu
title: Software Engineer — Payments Platforms, Distributed Systems & Security Architecture
subtitle: Architecture ownership across card and mobile-money rails, PCI-scoped systems, and multi-surface platforms
tagline: Designing and running mission-critical, money-moving systems across African fintech, mobility, energy access and health — hands-on, from release rail to ledger
summary: Software engineer with 11+ years designing, shipping and operating distributed, mission-critical systems — the last five in African fintech, mobility and energy access, where the systems move real money. Currently own platform architecture and data security for a mobility/fintech platform: five product surfaces and a mobile API behind one backend-for-frontend, 6,800+ unit tests, 280+ architecture decision records, an atomic release rail with automatic rollback, and card and mobile-money rails (Mastercard MPGS, M-Pesa, MTN, Tigo) built to PCI DSS SAQ-A scope with idempotent, fail-closed money paths. Earlier: CI/CD and quality gates for a PAYG solar platform across seven markets, an ML-security platform for medical-device software, and a digital-addressing pilot with a county government. Polyglot across TypeScript/Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, PHP, Python, Rust, Go and C#/.NET; deep in event-driven architecture, resiliency and fault-tolerance patterns, public cloud and containers, observability and secure SDLC. Set architecture direction across teams, mentor engineers (15+), and stay in production code every day.
